payload.title: Per-rule remediation hints, including generated paths such as Kanbus files
payload.description: Give per-rule advice (e.g. home path: use a relative path or $HOME). Let policy mark generated paths with a tool hint (project/events is written by Kanbus; fix it via kbs). Add a Kanbus integration regression test. (Biblicus #2 and #6, Babulus #5)
